'''Rann''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] serving the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on [[Carrick Station]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He worked the guild registrar.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rann appeared as a vendor for Republic players to form new guilds in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
